title: Recover rates from thermodynamics and relaxation
promptMarkdown: At 300 K a closed ideal A ⇌ B system has ΔrG°=−RT ln4, total concentration 0.250 M, and an experimentally measured relaxation half-time ln2/0.0500 min. Assume elementary first-order forward/reverse steps. Find K, equilibrium concentrations, k_f and k_r. Starting with B₀=0.0500 M, derive B(t) and calculate B at20.0 min. Then explain the required standard-state factor for the elementary reaction A ⇌ 2B instead.
hintLadder: The half-time describes the deviation from equilibrium, not necessarily half of B itself.
Solve a sum and a ratio for the two rates.
Write the dimensionless activity quotient before comparing it with a rate-constant ratio.
